day: # Lutheran Worship (1982, LCMS) -- readings: the three-year series (cycle A/B/C) and the one-year series
#   (title "One-Year Series"), the minor festivals and occasions (fixed dates), and the Daily Lectionary.
# SOURCE: Lutheran Worship (Concordia Publishing House, 1982), Propers of the Day, pp. 10-122, the READINGS
#   of each day (One-Year Series; Three-Year Series A, B, C), read from a scan of the pew edition
#   (October 2026).  Each column is Psalm, Old Testament (or first reading), Epistle (or second reading),
#   Holy Gospel, as printed; "or" joins an alternative.  A second Old Testament reading printed in the
#   Epistle's place (one-year Holy Monday and Wednesday, the Visitation, the Nativity of St. John the
#   Baptist, the Day of Supplication and Prayer) is kind ot2.  Parenthesized verses are optional, as printed.
# KEYS: LW numbers the Sundays after Pentecost 2-25 and gives fixed propers to the last three Sundays
#   (Third-Last, Second-Last, Last Sunday in the Church Year); unused numbered propers are dropped before
#   them.  So numbered Sundays are keyed after_pentecost:N while earlier than @fulfillment-14, and the last
#   three are keyed fulfillment with offsets -14 / -7 / 0.  Both series are printed on the same pages, so the
#   one-year propers keep the same keys.  The Nativity has three services (Christmas Eve, Christmas Dawn,
#   Christmas Day); Easter Eve, Easter Evening, Pentecost Eve and Pentecost Evening are Vespers or Evening
#   Prayer (Easter Eve and Pentecost Evening one-year only).  Easter Day (one-year) has three sets and the Day
#   of Pentecost (one-year) two, numbered as LW numbers them.
# FESTIVALS: LW's Commemoration of Pastors and Confessors (three-year only) serves St. Timothy and St. Titus;
#   its Commemoration of the Doctors of the Church (one-year only) serves Martin Luther, C. F. W. Walther
#   and the Presentation of the Augsburg Confession; the Commemoration of the Faithful Departed and New
#   Year's Eve have one-year readings only, Holy Cross Day three-year only.  The Visitation is 31 May.
# NOT INCLUDED: the occasions without a date (Dedication of a Church or Anniversary of a Congregation, Mission
#   Festival, Harvest Festival, Day of Supplication and Prayer).  The Day of Special or National Thanksgiving
# CHECKED against the printed book by the maintainer: 7th Sunday after Pentecost C, psalm (damaged in the scan):
#   Psalm 19; the Annunciation's Gospel: Luke 1:26-38 (the scan reads "1:25-38").
# This replaces the earlier reading of the three-year series from the LCMS chart, which often gave LSB's
#   verses for LW's and left many slots empty.

day: # DAILY LECTIONARY (title "Daily Lectionary", fixed dates MM-DD, every year): LW's one-year "Bible-in-a-Year" daily lectionary
#   (a psalm or monthly canticle + about three chapters a day).  Source: Faith Evangelical Lutheran Church (LCMS), Oak Ridge
#   "Daily Lectionary: A Bible-in-a-Year reading plan as printed in Lutheran Worship"
#   kind psalm = the psalm/canticle column (the month's canticle replaces the psalm on its first and last day); kind ot/nt = the
#   chapters, by testament.  No entry for 02-29.  Checked against LW itself (pp. 295-299, photographed
#   October 2026), which corrects the PDF's three slips: 01-23 Genesis 25-27 (PDF 26-27); 04-09 and 10-09 Psalm 119:17-24
